mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_RCDC001 (DC_ID, CP_ID, CS_ID, EVSE_ID, CUT_ID, EVCC_ID, ID_TAG_TP, CO_ID, CL_DT, PRD_TP, DCH_ST_DT, DCH_ED_DT, DCH_STAT_CD, DCH_US_AMT, DCH_US_CST, DCH_US_SUM, ST_DA_ELE_NRG, ED_DA_ELE_NRG, MAX_DCH_NRG, REG_DT, REG_ID, UPD_DT, UPD_ID) VALUES (#{discharging.dcId}, #{discharging.cpId}, #{discharging.csId}, #{discharging.evseId}, #{discharging.customerId}, #{discharging.evccId}, #{discharging.idTagType}, #{discharging.companyId}, #{discharging.closedDate}, #{discharging.productId}, #{discharging.dchStartDate}, #{discharging.dchEndDate}, #{discharging.dchStatCode}, #{discharging.dchUseAmount}, #{discharging.dchUseUnitCost}, #{discharging.dchUseCost}, #{discharging.startDaEleEnerge}, #{discharging.endDaEleEnerge}, #{discharging.maxDischargeEnergy}, NOW(), #{discharging.writer.registrationId}, NOW(), #{discharging.writer.registrationId})
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_RCDC001 SET CUT_ID = #{discharging.customerId}, EVCC_ID = #{discharging.evccId}, ID_TAG_TP = #{discharging.idTagType}, CO_ID = #{discharging.companyId}, CL_DT = #{discharging.closedDate}, PRD_TP = #{discharging.productId}, DCH_ST_DT = #{discharging.dchStartDate}, DCH_ED_DT = #{discharging.dchEndDate}, DCH_STAT_CD = #{discharging.dchStatCode}, DCH_US_AMT = #{discharging.dchUseAmount}, DCH_US_CST = #{discharging.dchUseUnitCost}, DCH_US_SUM = #{discharging.dchUseCost}, ST_DA_ELE_NRG = #{discharging.startDaEleEnerge}, ED_DA_ELE_NRG = #{discharging.endDaEleEnerge}, MAX_DCH_NRG = #{discharging.maxDischargeEnergy}, UPD_DT = NOW(), UPD_ID = #{discharging.writer.updateId} WHERE DC_ID = #{discharging.dcId}
mapper.select: SELECT DC.*, CP.CP_NM AS CP_NAME, DATE_FORMAT(DC.DCH_ST_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS DCH_ST_DT_STR, DATE_FORMAT(DC.DCH_ED_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS DCH_ED_DT_STR, CO.CO_NM AS COMPANY_NAME, CU.CUT_NM AS CUST_NAME, CU.MBL_PHN_NO AS MBL_PHONE_NO, CV.CAR_NM AS CAR_NAME, CV.CAR_NO AS CAR_NO FROM TB_RCDC001 DC LEFT JOIN TB_CHCP001 CP ON CP.CP_ID = DC.CP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_ORCP001 CO ON CO.CO_ID = DC.CO_ID LEFT JOIN TB_CUCU001 CU ON CU.CUT_ID = DC.CUT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_CUEV001 CV ON CV.EVCC_ID = DC.EVCC_ID WHERE DC.DC_ID = #{dcId}
